“哥布林，这个世界上最卑劣的魔物之一，尤其是爪牙种。
它们不司农牧，贪婪狡诈，崇拜魔王，像地里的蝗虫，杀之不尽，让人生厌。”
阳光透过窗口洒落，灰尘也仿若金粒熠熠生辉。
青苔石垒砌而成的台阶上，蓝袍法衫的老师正给孩子们讲课：
“但是，哥布林也分很多种类，有名为森奴种的哥布林，它们个头矮小，黑发褐瞳，容易屈服，是天生的奴隶。”
讲到此处时，一旁的女助教拍了拍手，站了出来：“拿笔记下来，以后可别分辨错了。”
“是的，古拉老师~”
孩子们兴致缺缺的应道。
马尔提雅，作为奴隶高度商品化的国度。
身为贵族如果连“货物”
和“魔物”
都分辨不清，那将沦为所有贵族的笑柄。
一条街的距离。
昏暗的室内，粗铁锈蚀与粪便发酵的气味混合刺鼻。
黎木迈着沉重的步伐，缓缓走上了押送囚犯的马车。
来到这里，已经一周了。

失去了部分记忆的黎木，在马尔提雅的街道上，很快就被当做森奴种哥布林被捉了起来。
又因为其异于寻常哥布林的身高和外貌，被鉴魔司判定为身携诅咒的异常个体，最终从奴隶又变成了现在的囚犯。
将送往特殊的监狱收容起来。
不知过去了多久。
“吱嘎~”
粗糙的铁门打开，黎木被丢了进去。
空腹带来的虚弱让黎木生不起反抗的意识和力气，瘫软的靠在墙壁上。
这是他第一次体验监狱，也是他这周第一次感到释然。
“喂，小子，你是雄性吧？怎么会被关到黑蔷薇监狱来的？”
“喂，小子！”
即将陷入昏睡的黎木，被身旁的声音吵醒。

"Goblin, one of the most despicable monsters in the world, especially the minions.
They are not farmers and herders, they are greedy and cunning, and they worship the devil. They are like locusts in the field, they are endless and annoying. "
The sun shines through the window, and the dust shines like gold particles.
On the steps made of moss and stones, the teacher in blue robe and robe is giving a lecture to the children:
"However, there are many types of goblins. There are goblins called Sennu. They are short in stature, have black hair and brown eyes, and are easy to yield. They are natural slaves."
When talking about this, the female assistant teacher on the side clapped her hands and stood up: "Take notes and write them down. Don't make mistakes in the future."
"Yes, Teacher Gula~"
The children responded without interest.
Martia is a country where slaves are highly commercialized.
As a nobleman, if you don't even have "goods"
and "monster"
If they can't tell the difference, they will become the laughing stock of all nobles.
One street away.
In the dark room, the smell of rusty iron and fermented feces was pungent.
Li Mu took heavy steps and slowly stepped onto the carriage escorting the prisoners.
It's been a week since I got here.
Li Mu, who had lost part of his memory, was quickly captured as a Sen slave goblin on the streets of Martiya.
And because of his unusual height and appearance, the Goblin was judged as an abnormal individual carrying a curse by the Demon Appraisal Division, and he eventually changed from a slave to a prisoner now.
Will be sent to a special prison for containment.
I don’t know how much time has passed.
"Squeak~"
The rough iron door opened and Li Mu was thrown in.
The weakness caused by an empty stomach prevented Li Mu from having the consciousness and strength to resist, and he leaned against the wall limply.
It was his first experience of prison, and for the first time this week he felt relieved.
"Hey, boy, are you a male? How come you were imprisoned in Black Rose Prison?"
"Hey, kid!"
Li Mu, who was about to fall into drowsiness, was woken up by the voice beside him.
